research_candidates.student_evidence_job: Compare areas and perimeters of equal-sized arrangements
research_candidates.mathematical_structure_not_source_item: Give distinct arrangements with equal area; decide whether perimeters or other structural properties are necessarily equal.
research_candidates.specific_qa_or_alignment_note: Do not treat same area as proof of equal perimeter; keep drawings answer-neutral.

research_candidates.student_evidence_job: Generalize a staged or layered pattern
research_candidates.mathematical_structure_not_source_item: Use a table of successive configurations to form an explicit rule, then justify that the rule holds for a later, unpictured stage.
research_candidates.specific_qa_or_alignment_note: Do not classify as linear unless first differences support it.

research_candidates.student_evidence_job: Compare triangle area on a lattice
research_candidates.mathematical_structure_not_source_item: Construct noncongruent triangles on dot paper with specified area and give a reason why they share that area.
research_candidates.specific_qa_or_alignment_note: Use exact lattice geometry; no unverified appeal to Pick formula.

research_candidates.student_evidence_job: Communicate a mathematical generalization with evidence
research_candidates.mathematical_structure_not_source_item: Use problem statement, labeled organization, computed case, generalized rule and evaluation as an assessment of reasoning quality, not a separate arithmetic family.
research_candidates.specific_qa_or_alignment_note: Recast in compact teacher-selected form, not mandatory boilerplate on every student page.

research_candidates.student_evidence_job: Count constrained pathways
research_candidates.mathematical_structure_not_source_item: Model a route network with explicitly permitted directions; find all valid routes and explain non-double-counting.
research_candidates.specific_qa_or_alignment_note: Use newly authored graph/network; verify all paths independently.

research_candidates.student_evidence_job: Convert hierarchical time units
research_candidates.mathematical_structure_not_source_item: Apply a nonstandard base conversion rule to a time display, with a reverse-conversion companion to distinguish place value from memorized factors.
research_candidates.specific_qa_or_alignment_note: A unit conversion task only if conversions have been taught; not ordinary seconds/minutes.

research_candidates.student_evidence_job: Construct a small sample space
research_candidates.mathematical_structure_not_source_item: Enumerate assignments with constraints, distinguish equally likely from merely possible outcomes, then calculate a probability.
research_candidates.specific_qa_or_alignment_note: Do not assume equally likely outcomes without specifying random process.

research_candidates.student_evidence_job: Describe a repeating calendar pattern
research_candidates.mathematical_structure_not_source_item: Identify a minimal cycle using periodic conditions and explain how a date shift changes the possible calendar structures.
research_candidates.specific_qa_or_alignment_note: Prefer mathematical modular reasoning over year-specific trivia.

research_candidates.student_evidence_job: Prove a number-pattern identity
research_candidates.mathematical_structure_not_source_item: Explore numerical differences between squares, classify which integer targets are possible and generalize using an algebraic identity.
research_candidates.specific_qa_or_alignment_note: Distinct from simply simplifying an expression; require original proof/counterexample evidence.

research_candidates.student_evidence_job: Compare routes on a rectangular prism surface
research_candidates.mathematical_structure_not_source_item: Unfold a surface to compare distinct routes between two surface points; distinguish surface shortest path from straight 3-D distance.
research_candidates.specific_qa_or_alignment_note: Verify geometry from actual net and show only needed student construction surfaces.

research_candidates.student_evidence_job: Reason about cross-sections and passage through an opening
research_candidates.mathematical_structure_not_source_item: Relate silhouettes, cross-sections and solids to determine if one object satisfies two geometric constraints.
research_candidates.specific_qa_or_alignment_note: Draw original diagrams; check whether constraints permit the claimed object.

research_candidates.student_evidence_job: Infer distance from an indirect right triangle
research_candidates.mathematical_structure_not_source_item: Translate a real-world observation into a right-triangle representation and select the correct unknown side.
research_candidates.specific_qa_or_alignment_note: The context and diagram must agree; verify all units.

research_candidates.student_evidence_job: Optimize a two-stage trip with unequal speeds
research_candidates.mathematical_structure_not_source_item: Represent time as a function of a transition point; compare candidate entry points and describe why a visually shortest route may not minimize time.
research_candidates.specific_qa_or_alignment_note: Reserve derivative optimization for Calculus; Precalculus version can compare tabulated/graphical models.

research_candidates.student_evidence_job: Plan a limited-information balance experiment
research_candidates.mathematical_structure_not_source_item: Choose successive weighings to isolate an unknown item; use a decision tree with clearly stated outcome branches.
research_candidates.specific_qa_or_alignment_note: This is deductive logic and may not assess equation solving despite shared balance representation.

research_candidates.student_evidence_job: Arrange tiles under fit/rotation constraints
research_candidates.mathematical_structure_not_source_item: Determine if and how a finite family of connected shapes can tile a specified rectangle without overlaps or gaps.
research_candidates.specific_qa_or_alignment_note: Rotation and reflection permissions must be explicit; verify with an independent tiling.

research_candidates.student_evidence_job: Translate integer constraints into an equation
research_candidates.mathematical_structure_not_source_item: Use a known relation between consecutive integers and their total to write a model and determine a valid integer solution.
research_candidates.specific_qa_or_alignment_note: Do not hand the student the equation when constructing it is the assessed job.

research_candidates.student_evidence_job: Model motion with and against a current
research_candidates.mathematical_structure_not_source_item: Compare elapsed time, distance and speed in two travel directions; infer a hidden rate from an invariant distance.
research_candidates.specific_qa_or_alignment_note: Use consistent distance and nonzero positive physical speeds.

research_candidates.student_evidence_job: Audit an approximate regular-polygon construction
research_candidates.mathematical_structure_not_source_item: Use angle or side relationships to test whether an outlined construction is regular; estimate approximation error rather than accepting appearances.
research_candidates.specific_qa_or_alignment_note: Requires confirmed exact geometry and precision tolerance.

research_candidates.student_evidence_job: Infer volume from a folding/cutting geometry model
research_candidates.mathematical_structure_not_source_item: Reconstruct a solid from its geometric constraints and compute a dimension-dependent volume.
research_candidates.specific_qa_or_alignment_note: Must independently verify the net and resulting dimensions.

research_candidates.student_evidence_job: Find near-coincidence of periodic events
research_candidates.mathematical_structure_not_source_item: Model two repeating event schedules and locate the first recurrence satisfying a time-tolerance constraint.
research_candidates.specific_qa_or_alignment_note: Distinguish exact coincidence from minimum time difference.

research_candidates.student_evidence_job: Complete a grid partition under constraints
research_candidates.mathematical_structure_not_source_item: Divide a lattice into regions meeting size and location requirements; determine whether multiple solutions are possible.
research_candidates.specific_qa_or_alignment_note: Validate uniqueness only if explicitly claimed.

research_candidates.student_evidence_job: Count hidden overlapping shapes
research_candidates.mathematical_structure_not_source_item: Develop a systematic category-by-category count of nested and composite shapes, with a duplicate-counting check.
research_candidates.specific_qa_or_alignment_note: Use custom accurate source-independent figure; shape counting alone may be extension rather than core family.

research_candidates.student_evidence_job: Construct a polygon from point-position constraints
research_candidates.mathematical_structure_not_source_item: Use fixed points and side-of-line relations to place other vertices; explain whether the configuration is possible.
research_candidates.specific_qa_or_alignment_note: Provide answer-neutral blank construction surface.

research_candidates.student_evidence_job: Recover a missing value in a network rule
research_candidates.mathematical_structure_not_source_item: Infer a relationship from multiple small branch examples then complete one unknown without assuming a pattern from only one example.
research_candidates.specific_qa_or_alignment_note: Require at least two known consistent branches; multiple possible rules should be accepted or prevented.

research_candidates.student_evidence_job: Build a valid arithmetic expression under restrictions
research_candidates.mathematical_structure_not_source_item: Insert operators or grouping symbols into a number list to satisfy a target, distinguishing order-of-operations errors from feasibility.
research_candidates.specific_qa_or_alignment_note: Determine whether exactly one solution is required; independently verify.

research_candidates.student_evidence_job: Study a compact mixed warm-up layout
research_candidates.mathematical_structure_not_source_item: Use independent short Reason, Solve, Sketch, Review prompts as a layout archetype; classify each prompt by evidence job, not as four new canonical families.
research_candidates.specific_qa_or_alignment_note: The current teacher has separately approved spacious two-choice Q1/Q2 with no ruled work area; do not replace it with four cramped boxes.

research_candidates.student_evidence_job: Contrast formula evaluation with graph construction
research_candidates.mathematical_structure_not_source_item: Present a short function-value calculation alongside a separate graph construction, preserving what each task independently assesses.
research_candidates.specific_qa_or_alignment_note: Keep function notation and answer-neutral axes; do not merge into one overloaded item.

research_candidates.student_evidence_job: Change the unknown in a literal formula
research_candidates.mathematical_structure_not_source_item: Provide a dimension/context relation and solve for a different unknown than usual; use a spatial sketch only if it clarifies rather than leaks the answer.
research_candidates.specific_qa_or_alignment_note: Verify volume, area and units; no extraneous art.

research_candidates.student_evidence_job: Eliminate cases from explicitly unreliable labels
research_candidates.mathematical_structure_not_source_item: Represent a small set of mislabeled categories as logical constraints and prove one remaining assignment works.
research_candidates.specific_qa_or_alignment_note: More logic than CPM curriculum evidence; never direct assessment replacement.

research_candidates.student_evidence_job: Compare rates with repeated intervals
research_candidates.mathematical_structure_not_source_item: Determine which repeated-event process reaches a target total first; use a common unit and attend to discrete timing.
research_candidates.specific_qa_or_alignment_note: Clarify whether counting includes t=0 initial event.

research_candidates.student_evidence_job: Subdivide a region under equal-portion restrictions
research_candidates.mathematical_structure_not_source_item: Plan an area partition with a limited number of straight or curved cuts; confirm actual equal areas after the partition.
research_candidates.specific_qa_or_alignment_note: Avoid using as geometric proof without verified area calculation.

research_candidates.student_evidence_job: Minimize operations on a linked system
research_candidates.mathematical_structure_not_source_item: Compare strategies for opening and closing components under a constrained sequence; justify a lower bound.
research_candidates.specific_qa_or_alignment_note: Useful problem solving but may be far from section learning targets.
